after_v041.note: Ed25519-signed checkpoint every 1000 appends; verification resumes from the latest valid checkpoint. Forged/mismatched checkpoints fall back to the full walk; chains without checkpoints validate as before.

before_v040.note: full scan: decrypt+tokenize every episode; strictly linear (~19 us/episode on this machine)
